scope: Same frozen longest-edge geometry recipe with explicit10GiB Mac worker ceiling after two preserved8GiB resource failures. Not a change to mesh admission or stiffness gates.

theory_scope: A power law is motivated by local traction-free corner singularities and graded-mesh research. The exponent is an a priori experimental choice, not a proven optimal3D elasticity rule or error bound.
after_preflight: Read every level and stopping reason. A larger pass guard is a resource decision, not permission to relax geometry/quality/budget or claim metric completion. Read memory feasibility before any solve.
refinement: Before bisection, propagate requested edge orbits to strictly longer edges in incident tets until locally longest leaves are reached. Preserve complete periodic orbits. Use maximum inherited geometry-only metric excess per added-node bound. No FE fields enter selection. Existing exact-map bisection and every quality/geometry/periodic/cap gate remain unchanged.
field_controls: Six affine strains plus deterministic nonlinear periodic nodal perturbations. They only verify nesting and periodicity; no equilibrium fields enter generation.
edge_metric_sampling: Maximum at both endpoints and quadratic edge midpoint
previous_evidence: 2710 of2767 requested orbits quality-blocked; 723 blocking tets have no legal single midpoint split. Full-edge red splitting also fails681of1011 globally single-edge-blocked tets. Treat shape-degrading split order before selecting any new density law.
